workspaces.name: Futures Curve Laboratory

capabilities: Historical cutoff curve for the first selected product; full investigations also calculate both products' curves.
Exact maturities, days to expiry and normalized prices.
Calendar spreads, maturity gaps, daily curve slope and annualized curve ratio.
Contango, backwardation, flat, mixed or insufficient-curve classification.
Unchanged-contract movement decomposed into modeled mechanical roll-down and residual curve shift.
Piecewise-linear interpolation only; unresolved funding/storage/delivery factors remain explicit.

workspaces.name: Mirage Investigation
workspaces.visible_pitch: Discover → explain → challenge → preserve; compare policies A/B/C
capabilities: Integrated pipeline: normalized residual analysis, both futures curves, prior analogs, chronological replay, Red Team, Ghost Market and survival analysis.
Prospective full-policy gates for robust-score agreement, maturity/geographic/specification evidence, lifecycle, liquidity and stress medians.
A/B/C policy comparison on the same contracts, dates, capital, liquidity and cost/execution assumptions.
Typed stage results and stage-start/stage-completion/failure records.
Explicit verdicts: REJECTED, INSUFFICIENT EVIDENCE or SURVIVES MODELED TESTS; failed audits take precedence.
Conservative evidence gates include all 11 stress classes, evaluated audits, 30 completed held-out trades, positive held-out net P&L, current candidate and no unresolved open position.
Records rejected signals, no-opportunity conclusions and insufficient evidence as valid research outcomes.

workspaces.name: Ghost Market
workspaces.visible_pitch: Joint bootstrap • 11 stress classes • tail outcomes and fragility
capabilities: Seeded circular moving-block bootstrap jointly samples paired returns to retain cross-leg and within-block dependence.
Integer lots, contract monetary multipliers, gross notional and residual fine-gold exposure.
Eleven base/adverse scenario classes with lifecycle/liquidity eligibility.
Median, mean, worst, fifth/ninety-fifth percentiles, positive scenario frequency and expected shortfall at 5% (requires at least 200 simulations).
Scenario distributions display up to 100 sampled outcomes; summary statistics use every configured path.
Historical return correlation, cost sensitivity and fragile/survives-modeled-medians indicator.
Adjustable random seed, path count, holding period, delay, costs/slippage and volatility multiplier.
Future fee assumptions freeze the cutoff-date schedule as a turnover-equivalent rate; no calibrated real-profit odds.

workspaces.name: Market Red Team
workspaces.visible_pitch: 21 executable checks with pass / fail / not-evaluable evidence
capabilities: Each check records attack ID, invariant, source evidence, procedure, status, severity and explanation.

Twenty-one checks cover dates, purity, quotation units, integer lots, expiry identity, roll contamination, future leakage, delayed fills, actual source Opens, lifecycle, costs, P&L/attribution, liquidity, local research logging, holdout retuning, sample confidence, neutrality, sample size, geography, imputation and mode separation.
Future-mutation audit compares cutoff-limited results; clearly labeled temporary probes are used only when needed, with a relaxed-cutoff positive control.
Temporary probe rows never become market observations or research returns.
Independent source-rejoining, cost reconstruction, lot/P&L reconciliation and lifecycle rechecks.
Untested or unresolved checks never count as passes; audit failures reject the investigation.

workspaces.name: Time-Locked Replay
workspaces.visible_pitch: Session clock • delayed Open fills • walk-forward and frozen holdout
capabilities: Load observed sessions, reveal one session per step, reset clock and view reveal progress.
Each UI step requests a new strict information cutoff; stale configuration invalidates the displayed replay.
Automatic expiry choice frozen from the first research session.
Close-based signals enter at later common-session Open; configurable holding period and entry/exit delays.
No Close/settlement substitution for missing Open; missing exit remains an open marked position.
Integer sizing constrained by combined fully funded gross notional, max lots and prior signal-session volume.
Lifecycle/specification changes, listing/tender/expiry and liquidity screens block invalid entries/fills.
Walk-forward thresholds fit prior absolute Z-scores; frozen final-period threshold and stable calendar boundary.
Chronological signal, suppression, rejection, entry and exit events; training windows and exact trade records.
Equity, realized/unrealized P&L, all-leg entry/exit costs, drawdown, return on capital, volatility, descriptive Sharpe and win rate.
Gold-factor contribution, relative-value accounting residual and quantified residual fine-metal exposure.
Held-out trade count/net P&L, training/snapshot hashes and reference baselines.
Reference comparisons: cash/no-trade, exact-expiry gold buy-and-hold mark and fixed long/short integer hedge mark; marked benchmarks do not establish actual final liquidation.

workspaces.name: Profit Survival Map
workspaces.visible_pitch: Cost × delay heatmap • break-even • holding, exit, liquidity and slippage slices
capabilities: Recomputes actual chronological replay for each cost/entry-delay grid cell, including integer quantities and cash flows.
Heatmap, trade count, gross/net P&L, drawdown and evaluated/not-evaluable flags.
Separate sensitivity slices for additional exit delay, slippage, minimum volume and holding period.
Volatility, liquidity, expiry-restriction and combined-stress summaries kept distinct from historical replay.
Highest tested profitable cost boundary for each delay.
Conditional total, fee and slippage break-even rates derived from zero-fee trade turnover.
Survival requires resolved positions, completed trades, positive completed net P&L, positive total equity change and lifecycle validity.

workspaces.name: Anomaly DNA
workspaces.visible_pitch: 11-feature analog search • prior-only outcomes • interpretable similarity
capabilities: Same exact-contract-pair search using 11 interpretable features.
Features: Z-score, robust Z-score, spread change, gold volatility, log volume, log OI, residual volatility, trend, persistence, time to expiry and maturity gap.
Robust median/MAD scaler fitted only to completed prior candidates, with standard-deviation fallback.
Distance-ranked historical matches; overlapping outcome horizons suppressed.
Every analog outcome completes strictly before the query cutoff.
Matched dates, feature vectors, similarity distance, lifecycle flag and signed residual outcome.
Sample count, median residual change and narrowing frequency; explicitly descriptive rather than profit prediction.

workspaces.name: Contract Genome

capabilities: Inspectable specification registry and observed exact contract identities/lifecycle coverage.
Expiry-contract-effective versions distinguish simultaneously traded contracts.
Four gold products with distinct lot size, quotation unit, purity and quote location.
Normalization, lot value, fine grams per lot and specification provenance flags.
Integer hedge minimizes residual fine-metal fraction within maximum lots and combined fully funded gross notional.
Residual fine grams, residual fraction and exact-metal-neutral indicator.
Lifecycle gating for verified spec, mode match, observation validity, listing date, tender start and expiry.
Separate fictional synthetic registry; unverified real provenance/calendar evidence blocks execution claims.
